condition_kinds.always: The word is bound or relied upon on every supported successful path.
condition_kinds.never: The word is not bound or relied upon in the supported relation.
condition_kinds.prefix: The condition is word_offset < extent after applying the recorded array/limit offsets.
condition_kinds.unknown: No coverage conclusion is permitted; reason is required.

coverage_request.meaning: Decide whether consumer reliance implies producer binding.

coverage_response.rule: covered may be true or false only when status is EXACT; UNKNOWN never suppresses another supported rule and never becomes safety evidence.

normalization.word_offset: zero-based within the named ABI array, independent of verifier-array and producer-prefix offsets
normalization.prefix_equivalence: same normalized extent and same normalized offset relation
